name: What preparatory steps should I take before a plumbing or electrical renovation project begins?
description: Clear work areas, document issues, ensure safety for children/pets, and discuss timelines/shut-offs with your contractor beforehand.

mainEntity.name: What preparatory steps should I take before a plumbing or electrical renovation project begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a plumbing or electrical renovation project starts, it's helpful to clear the work areas, ensuring easy access for the technicians. You should also consider documenting any existing issues or specific requests you have. If children or pets are present, plan for their safety and keep them away from active work zones. A key preparation step is to discuss the project timeline and any potential water or power shut-offs with your contractor, like Frasheski Construction, so you can plan accordingly and minimize disruption to your household.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear work areas, document issues, ensure safety for children/pets, and discuss timelines/shut-offs with your contractor beforehand.
